Its extraordinary 14.32-carat size, Bangkacha Mines origin, saturated Royal Blue colour, uniform appearance, eye-clean character, and window-free presentation combine to create a magnificent and highly distinctive statement sapphire.

Expertly fashioned in a well-balanced cushion cut, it offers excellent brilliance and is an outstanding choice for both fine jewellery and astrological wear.

The hue falls slightly toward the deeper side of the royal blue spectrum, giving the stone a distinguished and sophisticated appearance while retaining attractive vibrancy. Eye-clean in clarity, it presents a pleasing face-up appearance with no readily visible inclusions. Fashioned in an oval cut with well-balanced proportions, the sapphire shows no windowing, allowing the color to be fully retained within the gem and preventing any loss of saturation through the pavilion. This contributes to its strong visual depth and consistent face-up color. Standard heat treatment has been applied, a widely accepted practice in the sapphire trade. Its combination of desirable royal blue color, substantial size, and harmonious proportions makes it a fine example of a Madagascar blue sapphire.

column41: This 10.62-carat Burmese ruby displays a richly saturated pinkish-red color, a hue highly prized among rubies from Myanmar. Certified as unheated and untreated, the gemstone preserves its natural beauty without any enhancement. The stone exhibits visible rutile silk across the table, a characteristic feature often regarded as a hallmark of natural Burmese rubies and an important indicator of its untreated status. Fashioned in a native Burmese antique-style cushion cut, it retains the charm and individuality associated with traditional cutting practices. The combination of substantial size, desirable Burmese origin, natural silk inclusions, and vibrant pinkish-red coloration gives this ruby exceptional character and collector appeal.
